summary: Develop practical cross-cultural communication skills with workplace exercises on feedback, meetings, and digital teamwork. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Cross-cultural communication training helps professionals coordinate work across different communication expectations without treating cultural patterns as rules. For team leads, HR professionals, and client-facing specialists, it develops skills for adapting messages, checking assumptions and interpreting communication cues, and agreeing on clear norms for digital team collaboration.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate work, service, or decisions across culturally diverse teams and stakeholder relationships.
prerequisites: Prior experience working with colleagues, clients, or partners from different cultural backgrounds is recommended. No coding or formal cultural assessment experience is required. A laptop with access to Excel and Microsoft Teams is useful for the digital communication exercises.
